title: 8 Signs You're Chasing a Wife, Not God
caption:
Desperation has a smell. She can pick it up before you say a word.

A man chasing a wife panics at every wedding invite, prays more for her name than his own character, and edits his faith to whoever's in the room. A man chasing God does none of that. He's too busy becoming someone worth finding.

Check where your prayers actually point this week. That's where the chase really lives.

Get the order right. She was never the one you needed to be chasing.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #singleness #realtalk
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
